Speak, review, then care.

Learn about FloraTend's push-to-talk voice approach and device capability limits.

In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

Can I manage plants using voice commands?

FloraTend is being developed with push-to-talk commands and spoken responses where compatible Android speech recognition and TextToSpeech engines are available.

Availability depends on your device

Fire tablets may not include a compatible recognition engine. Voice language support depends on the installed engine and differs from interface language support. Offline recognition is not promised.

Touch remains available

Essential care actions are designed for touch and text too. Microphone access is requested when used; there is no planned continuous background listening or default raw-audio storage.
